ms.promise:
・This milestone aims to translate the background of the Cardano blockchain and Project Catalyst into five (5) local languages in Ghana such as; Dagbani, Twi, Hausa, Waala & and Ewe. This will enhance the understanding of the goals, aims and objectives of the Cardano ecosystem and Project Catalyst to the rural folks and the illiterates, making access to Cardano knowledge inclusive for the majority of the Ghanaian populace. It's evident that, when something is defined in the local language, it is easier for the local folks to understand it better than if expressed in a non-native tongue (English). These translations will be recorded and published on the socials of the Cardano Ghana Community and shared with the IO Team and Cardano community via the project monthly report forms. 
・The translated content will be published on the Cardano Ghana YouTube channel and the recordings and respective links will be shared with the Catalyst team and Cardano Community. 
・Complete monthly report forms with these outputs for the review of the Catalyst Team and onward public share with the wider Cardano Community.

ms.report:
Final Milestone (M3) - Compiled a Database of 500+ Cardano enthusiasts in Ghana
Overview:
The final milestone of the Cardano Ghana Community project has been successfully achieved. The project compiled a comprehensive database comprising 550+ entries of Cardano enthusiasts in Ghana. This includes members of the Cardano Ghana Community, ADA holders, enthusiasts, newbies, and individuals expressing interest in Cardano through community events.
Database Details: The compiled database is organized into 9 separate sheets, containing responses from various events and data related to the Cardano Ghana Community. This diverse dataset encompasses valuable information for effective communication and collaboration within the Cardano community in Ghana.
Data Utilization: The primary purpose of this database is to support the marketing efforts of Input Output Global and the Cardano Foundation. It will empower the marketing team to communicate newsletters, updates, and opportunities directly to the local Ghanaian Cardano community. This targeted approach aims to enhance communication, foster innovation, and encourage collaboration among Cardano enthusiasts in Ghana.
Data Security: To ensure data protection and privacy, the compiled database has been shared privately with the Catalyst team at Input Output Global ( catalyst@iohk.io ). This step aligns with best practices in safeguarding sensitive information and upholding the principles of responsible data management. 
Conclusion: The successful compilation of this comprehensive database marks a significant achievement for the Cardano Ghana Community project. The rich information gathered will serve as a powerful resource for fostering a stronger and more interconnected Cardano community in Ghana. This milestone sets the stage for continued growth, innovation, and collaboration within the Cardano ecosystem in Ghana.
